name: hermodmail
description: HermodMail — modern open-source webmail for humans and AI agents

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @hermodmail/web && npm run build --workspace @hermodmail/server

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @hermodmail/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @hermodmail/web
